title: Conformalized Quantile Regression and Minimax Limits of Fixed-Score Calibration under Known Covariate Shift
abstract: arXiv:2609.24929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study nonasymptotic $L^p$ error bounds for interval length and conditional coverage in split conformalized quantile regression (CQR). Our bounds rely on local regularity conditions and accuracy guarantees for the estimated quantiles. We further instantiate our bounds for quantile regression with sparse ReLU neural networks. We also consider covariate shift, where the calibration and test covariates have different distributions, and derive nonasymptotic bounds for this setting. We obtain matching minimax upper and lower bounds in expectation for two constructed fixed-score calibration benchmarks under known covariate shift. The bounds match for every $p\in[1,\infty]$ in the scalar problem and for finite $p$ in the $K$-threshold problem; for the latter, a high-probability minimax lower bound holds for every $p\in[1,\infty]$.

translated_title: 已知协变量偏移下保形分位数回归与固定分数校准的极小极大极限
translated_abstract: 本文研究了分裂保形分位数回归（CQR）中区间长度和条件覆盖的非渐近 $L^p$ 误差界。我们的界依赖于局部正则性条件以及对估计分位数的精度保证。我们进一步针对基于稀疏 ReLU 神经网络的分位数回归实例化了这些界。我们还考虑了协变量偏移的情形，即校准协变量与测试协变量服从不同分布，并针对该设定推导了非渐近界。在已知协变量偏移下，我们为两个构造的固定分数校准基准问题得到了期望意义下匹配的极小极大上下界。这些界在标量问题中对所有 $p\in[1,\infty]$ 均匹配，在 $K$ 阈值问题中对有限 $p$ 匹配；对于后者，对所有 $p\in[1,\infty]$ 均成立高概率极小极大下界。
tldr: 本文为分裂保形分位数回归的区间长度与条件覆盖建立了非渐近 $L^p$ 误差界，并在已知协变量偏移下针对固定分数校准基准问题证明了期望意义下匹配的极小极大上下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes nonasymptotic $L^p$ error bounds for interval length and conditional coverage in split conformalized quantile regression, and proves matching minimax upper and lower bounds in expectation for fixed-score calibration benchmarks under known covariate shift.
